title: Course registry
description: data/courses.json: the portal's only build-time input.

id.description: Stable lowercase ASCII slug; Persian belongs in titles, never in IDs or URLs.

manifestUrl.description: Absolute HTTPS URL of the course's course.json.

status.description: Only 'published' is fetched into the public catalog.

centers.description: Teaching-center ids this course belongs to; must reference data/centers.json. A course may have zero, one, or many centers.

localPath.description: Optional relative or absolute path to a local course.json file for offline development. It is used only when PORTAL_LOCAL=1.
